validation.roster_assignment: feature-season team only; target-season team is forbidden
validation.market_note: The standalone preseason feature models did not improve a calibrated 60-minute Polymarket probability and are not promoted as market-beating game-day features.

playoffs.methodology_note: Qualification, exact division/wildcard position and playoff advancement are simulated jointly across the complete released schedule. Every team with a non-zero path is retained in each bracket slot probability bar. The adjacent decision-specific qualification probability is kept separate because its richer role/fantasy feature set was validated for making the playoffs, not for individual game outcomes.

recent_basis: Recent mover lists use custom rating changes versus the 2026-03-27 snapshot, which is the day before the weighted-median 10th most recent team game. Skater movers use overall talent score, team movers use total team score, goalie movers use goalie score, and usage lists compare the most recent 10 games to the previous 10.
